objective: Test whether one deterministic, price-only strategy adds after-cost and after-tax return over the S&P 500 Total Return index in EUR without exceeding the configured risk budget.
hypothesis: A small active sleeve allocated to point-in-time S&P 500 constituents with positive 12-minus-1-month benchmark-relative momentum and a positive 200-trading-day trend will produce positive net active return.

execution.signal_time: last common market close of each calendar month
execution.fill_time: next common market close after the signal

universe_track.membership: point-in-time S&P 500 membership on the signal date
universe_track.removed_constituent_handling: move its weight to the benchmark at the first available close after removal

personal_portfolio_track.source: transactions available on or before each historical decision date
personal_portfolio_track.baseline: actual reconstructed holdings with position-changing cash flows neutralized at the close

tax_scenarios.standard: FIFO lots, acquisition fees in basis, per-lot Finnish 20/40 percent deemed-cost comparison, and annual 30/34 percent capital-income brackets.
tax_scenarios.espp: Unsupported without employment-income and qualifying-disposition fields; affected scope fails closed.

anti_overfitting.revision_rule: Any signal, portfolio-construction, cost, tax, split, or threshold change requires a new version and a new future holdout.
